fusions.name: Twin Scratch
fusions.desc: A two-pronged scratch that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that damage.

fusions.name: Branching Rally
fusions.desc: Hurls a pronged bolt that deals 26 damage to the first enemy in its path and splits to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that damage. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Upright Tines
fusions.desc: Sets a pitchfork upright by the nearest enemy. It waits 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 16 damage in a blast around it. Its effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Other Path
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
